new_findings.criterion: P3-C-AC2 (feedback-capable typed topology; negative control on the theoretical-sampling loop; spec 5.8 'Grounded theory's constant comparison is a required cycle')
new_findings.correction: The loop sends only the successor source increment back to initial_code. The previously developed categories never re-enter compare_memo, focus_categories or refine: no connection targets those moves with revised_categories_with_properties_and_gaps. As a result, a second or later pass builds and refines categories from the new increment alone, successor codes are never compared against the existing categories, and integrate (via p05.c14) receives only the last pass's categories. To fix this, add an optional slot 'prior_revised_categories' (type concept, role prior, cardinality optional_many) to compare_memo and to focus_categories and/or refine. Then add a feedback or retained_context connection from p05.move.refine (revised_categories_with_properties_and_gaps) to those slots, taken on successor passes. Finally, state in refine's method_owned_rule (or in an uncertainty item) that each successor category version supersedes and carries forward the prior set.

new_findings.criterion: P3-C-AC2 (typed topology: every required input has a compatible source)
new_findings.correction: The only connection that supplies candidate_strategies is feedback p10.c12, so the first evaluate pass (and run_ensemble) has a required input with no source. To fix this, give p10.move.frame an output 'initial_candidate_strategies' (type option, many), derived from its candidate_actions/levers, and add an artifact_flow from frame to evaluate.candidate_strategies and to run_ensemble. Alternatively, declare candidate_strategies an external design input of the frame and carry it to evaluate as retained context.

new_findings.quote: p13.c19 retained_context p13.move.qual_warrant -> p13.move.meta_infer ... p13.c23 prohibited_transition from: p13.move.qual_warrant to: p13.move.meta_infer reason: one_strand_alone_cannot_license_a_mixed_methods_meta_inference
new_findings.criterion: P3-C-AC2 (exact typed topology; spec 5.8: prohibited_edges are validation rules, not documentation)
new_findings.correction: The same from/to pairs are both required retained-context connections and listed prohibited edges. An engine that enforces prohibited_edges would therefore block meta_infer's required strand inputs, or else the rule cannot be enforced. To fix this, express the rule as a guard on meta_infer: it is reachable only through control/artifact flow from p13.move.fit (c18), with both strand slots non-optional. Alternatively, retarget c23 and c24 to the actual bypass, for example qual_warrant/quant_warrant -> meta_infer without fit, using a distinct condition the validator can test. Also fix c24's 'to_input: qualified_qualitative_findings', which should be qualified_quantitative_findings.

new_findings.criterion: P3-C-AC1/AC2 (spec 5.0a: methodological_support only where a frozen source requires it and produces no claim; rule 4)
new_findings.correction: p13.u07 states that 'No frozen source gives explicit guidance on checking each strand's validity before merging', yet the move licenses merge, return or withhold, which changes what the method may conclude. methodological_support therefore fails both conditions in 5.0a. Reclassify it as analytic and update p13.phase.integrate.operation_kinds, or record the classification choice and its effect on the abort-gate denominator in p13.u07.
